'''Mil Mikkir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] manager of of an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] construction company owned by his father during [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He spent some of his youth roaming [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] where he briefly dabbled with a mild form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. He later attended an auction on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] with the intent of acquiring the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] to prevent his ex-lover, [[Shreya Ordassa]] from obtaining it.
